children: Analysts: TD Cowen holds PATH at Hold, $16 PT noting ~20.8% upside and >30% non‑GAAP margins focus; Needham keeps Buy, $22 PT citing larger customer mix; UBS cuts PT to $15.
Truist cut UiPath (PATH) price target to $14 from $17, kept Hold after Investor Day. Management showed roadmap, regulated-industry push, no new financial targets; Q2 revenue $410M, +13%.
Perpetual instruments (PATH, CYPH, HUT) now track UiPath Class A (PATH) price via index and oracle feeds, enabling continuous crypto-style trading without share delivery or voting rights.
UiPath (PATH) released Automation Suite for Linux, bringing its full agentic AI stack to Linux so firms can run automation, data and policies on-premises with governance and visibility.
UiPath (PATH) launched Data Fabric: unified, governable query layer for agents/workflows, with zero-copy federated links to Salesforce/SAP, new API, improved tools and full audit trails.
UiPath (PATH) rolled out UiPath Coding Agents, supporting multiple code models and native integration with folders, jobs, queues, assets and logs — enabling live natural‑language automation requests.
PATH announced platform updates: Database Hub (SQL Server, Oracle, Databricks access without custom code), Relay for cloud-to‑on‑prem connections, Third‑Party Credential Store, and MCP Connector.
PATH upgraded Test Cloud with autonomous test runs, AI-agent exploration, and broader automation across the testing lifecycle, boosting test autonomy and governance within a managed platform.
UiPath (PATH) unveiled Autopilot, an AI assistant that interprets and runs manual tests without prebuilt automation. Autopilot targets autonomous test execution and is due to launch October 2026.
UiPath (PATH) will add Playwright support to UiPath Test Cloud, letting teams run Playwright tests via Test Manager and link to test management; public preview set for October 2026.
